title: RESEARCH: verify OpenPGP resplen<2 underflow — may be safe
description: Reviewer flagged wp11_openpgp_sign/authenticate/get_ard as potentially having an unsigned underflow on resplen-2. Counter-analysis: all three functions check 'if (resplen < 2u) return WP11_OPENPGP_ERR_SW' before doing resplen-2. This means resplen=0 and resplen=1 both return error before the subtraction. Need to read the actual source code and confirm this check fires before any arithmetic. If confirmed safe, add a comment to each function: 'resplen >= 2 guaranteed here; check above prevents underflow.' Close as not-a-bug or fix if the check is actually missing.
